description: Generalized cross-site benchmark extension with public pages and no answer-leaking hints in scenarios.

scenarios.goal: Open https://www.openstreetmap.org/about and extract one primary page value as a single scalar field.
scenarios.description: Single value extraction on a public informational page.
scenarios.notes: Public informational site with stable heading structure.

scenarios.goal: Open https://www.iana.org/domains/root/db and extract a repeated structured listing of entries from the main content area.
scenarios.description: Repeated listing extraction from tabular content.
scenarios.notes: Designed to validate table_rows/table_like fallbacks without regex overfitting.

scenarios.goal: Open https://www.python.org, navigate to a documentation-related page through visible navigation, then extract one primary value from the destination page.
scenarios.description: Navigation then extraction on stable global navigation.
scenarios.notes: Focuses on click role/name and href_contains navigation robustness.

scenarios.goal: Open https://www.spbstu.ru and extract one primary page value as a single scalar field.
scenarios.notes: Russian-language scenario on a public university website.

scenarios.goal: Open https://www.wikipedia.org and determine whether an ungrounded or ambiguous target value can be extracted; if evidence is insufficient, return an explicit uncertain/negative outcome.
scenarios.description: Negative ambiguous benchmark case requiring explicit reject behavior.
scenarios.notes: Checks reject behavior under ambiguity without answer hints.

scenarios.goal: Open https://www.ietf.org/standards/rfcs/ and compare two meaningful page sections, then produce a combined comparison result.
scenarios.description: Section comparison scenario with multi-step extraction and structured compare output.
scenarios.notes: Validates generalized section comparison without fixed headings in scenario JSON.
